fun_facts: Sterling Shepard was born in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma.
He spent four years playing for Oklahoma in Norman.
In 2014, he received the Disney Spirit Award.
In his senior season, he caught 69 passes for 1,114 yards and 10 touchdowns.
In a double-overtime win over Tennessee, he caught the game-winning touchdown and also had 40 yards in punt returns.

After four years in Norman, former Oklahoma wide receiver Sterling Shepard will enter the 2016 NFL Draft. He will certainly be missed by his Sooner teammates.

Most notably, he’ll be missed by current Oklahoma quarterback Baker Mayfield. Mayfield and Shepard only played together for one season, but it was an epic one. Wednesday is Shepard’s birthday, and Mayfield decided not only to acknowledge that on his Instagram page, but also gave a heartfelt tribute to one of his good friends. Check it out:

> Feb 10, 2016 at 8:19am PST

Some of the best things about college football are the relationships that come with it, and Mayfield and Shepard exemplify that very well.

excerpts:
Oklahoma wide receiver Sterling Shepard and Arkansas running back Jonathan Williams, who missed the season rehabilitating a foot injury, are among the latest 2016 [NFL Draft](http://www.nfl.com/draft) prospects to accept an invitation to compete at the Reese's [Senior Bowl](http://www.nfl.com/seniorbowl) .

Williams is expected to recover from his injury in time to participate, according to a [Senior Bowl release](http://www.seniorbowl.com/news-highlights-detail.php?news=424 "srbowl") . Shepard has enjoyed a career-best season as a senior, catching 69 passes for 1,114 yards and 10 touchdowns for an Oklahoma team that has a chance to provide him a College Football Playoff stage from which to impress NFL scouts.
citations.title: Sterling Shepard among 17 additions to Senior Bowl roster | Latest NFL News, Analysis & Updates | NFL.com

excerpts:
receiver prospects available for the 2016 [NFL Draft](http://www.nfl.com/draft) on Saturday in Oklahoma's 31-24 road win over Tennessee in double overtime. But more important to the Sooners and OU coach Bob Stoops, he did it when his team needed him most.

Shepard slipped past multiple defenders despite being hemmed in on the right sideline for a game-winning touchdown catch in double overtime:

Shepard caught seven passes for 74 yards and two touchdowns on the night from new Sooners quarterback Baker Mayfield. Tennessee had control of the game for more than three quarters, taking a 17-3 lead into the fourth quarter before two late Oklahoma touchdowns forced overtime. Shepard also had 40 yards in punt returns to help field position for an OU offense that was anemic for most of the night.
citations.title: Sterling Shepard keys Oklahoma's OT win over Tennessee | Latest NFL News, Analysis & Updates | NFL.com
